description: Wasserschutzgebiete, NGP 2021, Österreich is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.lfrz.gv.at. Water protection areas of the Länder for drinking water supply (protection of existing water supply facilities in accordance with the Water Law Act § 34(1)). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas, NGP 2021, Austria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserschongebiet. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GML, WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
